title: Extract public assistant text
responsibility: Extracts text parts from assistant events while ignoring other event content.

inputs.name: publicCliEvents.value
inputs.description: The candidate CLI event. It must be an assistant event with a message object and content array to yield text.

outputs.name: publicCliEvents
outputs.description: An ordered list of string text parts whose type is text. Non-assistant events, malformed structures, reasoning parts and tool bodies produce no text entries.
